newsitem.title: USA: US jet fuel prices ease in sluggish holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: US jet fuel prices ease in sluggish holiday trade.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel slipped Monday as skittish buyers balked at seasonally high prices, players said, adding activity was restrained as many traders observed Yom Kippur, the holiest Jewish holiday.
Gulf Coast aviation-quality 54-grade fuel was talked 0.10 cent below October futures to about 0.15 cent over, players said, amid slightly higher October futures.

"There's a lack of buying interest because the numbers are too high," one Gulf trader said. He noted although diffs have eased over 1.50 cents since last week, absolute prices are about one cent higher because of steeper heating oil prices.
